# Expense Reimbursement

Employees are reimbursed for reasonable business expenses submitted through the Tallyhoo expense tool.

## Deadlines

Expenses must be submitted within 45 days of the purchase date, with an itemised receipt attached.

## Limits

Meals while travelling are capped at 85 US dollars per day. Alcohol is not reimbursed unless it is part of an approved client dinner.

## Approvals

Expenses up to 2,500 US dollars are approved by the employee's manager. Any single expense above 2,500 US dollars also needs sign-off from a vice president. Finance pays approved expenses in the next payroll run.
